description: Continue a chat with follow-up instructions or answers — the agent keeps its context. Resumes a run waiting in needs_input, or queues a new run when the last one finished. Returns run_busy while a run is still in progress. Optionally waits for the reply.

chat_id.description: A chat id (aichat_...). A run id works too — it resolves to that run's chat.

idempotency_key.description: Always pass one, unique to this message. Retrying with the same key returns the run the first call started instead of sending the message twice.

message.description: The follow-up to send into the conversation.

response_format.description: Ask for a JSON reply instead of prose: a JSON Schema, or OpenAI's {type: "json_schema", json_schema: {schema}}. The settled run then carries the parsed value in `json`, validated against the schema, or why it failed in `json_error`.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the reply before returning (default 0: return the new run immediately). Capped like ask_crevio's wait.

name: send_message

outputSchema.description: A task run — one delegated job and what is known about its state.

items.description: A file the work produced. Exchange its id for a download link with get_file_download_url.

cancel_requested_at.description: Set once a stop was requested; the run stays running until it reaches its next step, then settles as cancelled.

json.description: The reply parsed as JSON and validated against response_format. Present only when one was given.

json_error.description: Why the reply did not parse or validate against response_format.

wait_timed_out.description: The wait ended first. The work is still running: follow it with the tool next_step names.
